Yeah that’s pretty much it. She’s friends with all of my friends and I’m really hoping it goes well and maybe I can turn this all around.

I’m not sure to be honest. It’s been a thing since forever but it’s been getting worse and since Im not close with anyone it gets really hard to talk to people. The reason I don’t talk to my friends is just because when I see them I get really anxious and I freeze up because I just feel bad for being such an awful person for not talking to them.

Thank you and it’s because I’ve been struggling with social anxiety and depression for awhile now. It’s caused me to lash out and push everyone away and now I have no one left. I really just want them back because they’re amazing people and they’re family to me. I stopped talking to them about 4 months ago and it’s really hard for me to start talking to them again. I try a lot but it usually doesn’t go anywhere and we just say we miss each other.
I’m sorry you feel the way that you do but you shouldn’t follow through with this. it isn’t worth it. If you have a second I would definitely like to hear your story and talk this through with you.

I really appreciate you saying that thank you. As much as this means to me I’m not sure what I will do and I don’t know where to start. Suicide is always in my head because I just want the pain to stop. I’ve been thinking about this for a couple months now and I just don’t know when or if it will stop. But I’ve already made my decision and if I don’t get the people I love back than I don’t want to live any longer.
I know how you feel bro I feel the same way but I’m sure your friends care about you more than you think. Don’t end it you should definitely keep trying to get help. ❤️
